name: Domestic Dread
source:
You wake up in an unfamiliar cabin atop the mountains. Your best friend tells you that your boyfriend just tried to kill you, and now he's tied up in the other room.

Explore the cabin to try to uncover more details about your past life, and why you would want to get rid of your boyfriend.

[From [url=https://epykslion.itch.io/domestic-dread]Itch.io[/url]]
